title: fix(gateway): prevent workspace icon failures after startup
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes workspace icons returning HTTP 500 after successful Gateway startup, with repeated AbortError stacks in the Gateway log.

## User Impact

HTTP reads use a live request lifetime. Disconnects cancel cooperating work quietly, shutdown closes unfinished responses, and acknowledged hooks continue under their independent Gateway lifetime. Unexpected errors retain their diagnostics. Operators can observe cancellations through `openclaw_gateway_http_cancelled_total{source="client"|"shutdown"}`. Normal cancellations stay out of the stability event buffer.

## Why This Change Was Made

HTTP listeners inherited the startup AsyncWorkScope after the run loop retired it. Requests now enter the live Gateway owner and get a disconnect-aware child scope. Cancellation and draining restore that request context so abort listeners can schedule cleanup and the Gateway joins it before releasing resources.

The transport owner records successful response completion before Node's normal connection-close handling. This matters on Node 24, which can emit `finish` with `writableFinished=true` after a buffered write loses its socket. Normal `Connection: close` responses and server-selected rejections remain excluded from cancellation counts.

Current UI already deduplicates these image loads. The tested virtual-remount flow issued one metadata request and one image request, retained the image across an actual row unmount/remount, and produced zero failed/cancelled media requests. No UI patch was justified by this evidence.

Non-test/non-doc LOC: **+120**, using the requested diff filter. The growth supplies the missing cancellation/cleanup lifetime and bounded metric. Existing metric cases move to their current timing owner, and the now-unneeded line-limit suppression is removed. No user configuration, schema, or dependency change.

## Evidence

Full public Gateway with synthetic state and a paired-device token; startup retired before the first request:

| Measurement | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Workspace-icon raw requests | 4/4 returned 500 | 4/4 returned 200 |
| Matching raw-request error records | 4 | 0 |
| Errors per fresh headless browser connection (3 rounds) | 1 | 0 |
| Browser cancellations per connection | 0 | 0 |

Document, JS, agent-avatar, user-avatar, and assistant-media controls remained 200. The comparison used real routes and public Gateway startup, with no injected route or minimal Gateway. The final rebased candidate also passed all six route families on Node 24, logged zero HTTP errors, and shut down cleanly. The UI proof used current source served by the existing Vite E2E helper and a mocked Gateway; it is not a packaging test.

- Original-code regression failed with 500 instead of 200 on `blacksmith-testbox` lease `tbx_01m4fcnm2krqcahzgh6qjjm3y4`.
- Pre-rebase proof on `tbx_01m4fppr74xnj09jgfva92r0pq`: 16 HTTP lifetime cases passed (30.70s cold one-worker wall time), 92 lifecycle/diagnostics/Prometheus cases passed, and 358 Gateway siblings passed with one independently reproduced baseline failure. Export collision and eager-import/PR-wrapper closure guards passed (20 closure tests).
- Negative controls failed for the intended reasons: retired startup caused 500; ambient abort dispatch lost cleanup ownership; omitting the rejection receipt counted a delivered 413; Node 24 completion-property tracking lost a buffered cancellation.
- Final integration on `blacksmith-testbox` lease `tbx_01m4ft94fhkbp987fnshcbxz84`: exact staged tree verified; core, extension, and scripts lint passed; **123 affected tests passed** through `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs … --maxWorkers=1` in 53.80s. The full `node scripts/check-changed.mjs --staged --base f8e594e461efa21db360d345e986a2d0a543d5a4` gate passed all typechecks and early guards. Its only failure is the dead-export scan; unchanged main source at that exact base reproduces the same four findings. Every remaining check from the owning plan was run separately and passed, including lint, schema, import-cycle, webhook, and pairing guards. The complete integration batch took 39m58s.
- CI consumer repair on AWS Crabbox lease `cbx_a4477a7324ca` after Testbox `tbx_01m4fy9mykahqexnx71ky785j9` stalled in admission: the old recorder failed with `expected 4 to be 3`; `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/logging/diagnostic-stability.test.ts src/logging/diagnostic-stability-bundle.test.ts src/infra/diagnostic-events.test.ts extensions/diagnostics-prometheus/src/service.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` passed **84 tests in 40.98s**. Core and logging-test typechecks passed. After simplifying the callback for the executable-line ratchet, the final source passed **37 logging/bundle tests in 33.65s**, targeted lint, both size ratchets, formatting, and diff checks. That final run took 4m29s end to end. All leases are stopped.
- Independent review is clean through P2, including the stability-recorder repair. The rebase preserved both Prometheus tests; follow-ups make existing return values explicit, remove an unused suppression, and exclude metric-only cancellations from stability records.

Known old-base failure: `server.hooks-admission.test.ts` / `returns typed admission failures and leaves the idempotency key retryable` returned 502 instead of 200 on both candidate and unchanged `15305ccd53dedd1663a89f92a402480d7b71bbf8`. The dead-export findings also reproduce on main base `f8e594e461efa21db360d345e986a2d0a543d5a4`: `bindCliQuestionAnswerAuthority`, `prepareSessionEventTargetForHost`, `readSessionEntryCreationTransition`, and `RESTART_CONTINUATION_CONTEXT_PREFIX`. These scans remain failed; no baseline or ignore exception was added.

Historical logs did not include URLs, so the original production route distribution remains unmeasured. The reproduced AbortError originated in server startup retirement; this proof found no reduction in browser aborts. The previous-head CI run (`37906971427`, head `7441d36e6ea54a0c96e6ef8aec637b6e067b1d44`) took 12m51s wall time and 14,012 summed executed-job seconds. All Node tests and all nine UI E2E shards passed; its sole root failure was the newly added event missing from the stability recorder's exhaustive switch. That omission is repaired here and covered by the existing bounded-projection regression. Updated-head CI (`37912289175`, head `ec1d1a4a42202ec639df3db8e404e5e5f4cfdc23`) passes the repaired lint shard. It has one independently confirmed inherited type failure: `src/cli/update-cli.windows-lifecycle.test.ts(545,11)`, TS2554 from calling a signal listener without its argument. Scheduled main run `37912611958`, job `113761463036`, fails identically on the exact tested baseline `cff1f4fcb9015c99af0c3b104d88ed13fa08b309`; the test, type configuration, package manifest, and lockfile are byte-identical in the PR merge. Main already fixes it in `3223e13a514c6134e10ee7f585627434d245fd20`. Final CI completed in **15m38s wall time**, including 2m17s queued, and **15,172 summed job seconds**: 65 passed, 22 skipped, and only the inherited root plus aggregate failed. All nine UI E2E shards passed. ClawSweeper reviewed the exact final head with zero findings and no pre-merge actions. This PR uses the authorized inherited-CI landing exception; no CI rerun or branch refresh was requested.
